target datalayout = "e-p:64:64-i64:64-n32:64-S128"

%Pair = type { ptr, ptr }

@escaped = global ptr null

declare ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64)

define void @exact_field() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %write = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %write
  %read = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  %q = load ptr, ptr %read
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @disjoint_field() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %first = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %first
  %second = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 1
  store ptr null, ptr %second
  %q = load ptr, ptr %second
  store ptr %q, ptr @escaped
  ret void
}

define void @overlapping_whole_read() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %field = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %field
  %whole = load %Pair, ptr %object
  %q = extractvalue %Pair %whole, 0
  store ptr %q, ptr @escaped
  ret void
}

define void @overwritten_before_read() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca %Pair
  %write = getelementptr %Pair, ptr %object, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr %root, ptr %write
  store ptr null, ptr %write
  %q = load ptr, ptr %write
  store ptr %q, ptr @escaped
  ret void
}

define void @unknown_offset(i64 %index) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %array = alloca [2 x ptr]
  %element = getelementptr [2 x ptr], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 %index
  store ptr %root, ptr %element
  %q = load ptr, ptr %element
  store i8 1, ptr %q
  ret void
}

define void @undef_destination() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  store ptr %root, ptr undef
  ret void
}

define void @null_destination() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  store ptr %root, ptr null
  ret void
}

define void @null_pointer_valid() #0 {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  store ptr %root, ptr null
  ret void
}

define void @unsupported_destination(ptr %destination) {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  store ptr %root, ptr %destination
  ret void
}

define void @invalid_pointer_info() {
entry:
  %root = call ptr @"github.com/goplus/llgo/runtime/internal/runtime.AllocU"(i64 8)
  %object = alloca ptr
  store ptr %root, ptr %object
  %address = ptrtoint ptr %object to i64
  ret void
}

attributes #0 = { "null-pointer-is-valid" }
